description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller that serves as a fallback for unmapped HTTP requests. Its purpose is to return a JSON response with a 404 status code for undefined paths, while allowing certain API and static resource paths to pass through without interception.

classes.name: NotFoundFallbackController
classes.description: A REST controller that provides a fallback response for unmapped URLs to prevent 500 errors and instead return a structured 404 JSON response.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Handles all requests not matched by other controllers; returns a 404 JSON response unless the path is in the allowlist.

methods.name: startsWithAny
methods.description: Helper method to check if a given path starts with any of the specified prefixes.
